name: Access Event Evidence Package
tagline: Builds one bounded local JSON package per Access door event holding the original event id and metadata, observed analytics counts, and an operator review history.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name to package; unset packages every door in the event buffer.
config_schema.event_kinds: Access kinds to package from granted, denied, forced_open, held_open, doorbell, unlock_command, door_closed (default all).
config_schema.sample_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after each event before the package is written (default 12).
config_schema.max_packages: Newest packages kept in the local package store (default 500).
config_schema.retention_days: Days a package is kept before it is pruned (default 30).
config_schema.person_confidence: Detection confidence used for the packaged counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the package (default false).

name: Access Incident Search Index
tagline: Writes one bounded local index record per Access door event joining door, result kind, credential method, and timestamp with the counts observed on the correlated camera.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name to index; unset indexes every door in the event buffer.
config_schema.sample_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after each event before its record is written (default 10).
config_schema.max_records: Newest index records kept in the local file (default 2000).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for the indexed counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the index record (default false).

name: After-Hours Activity
tagline: Flags a detected person during configured closed hours and saves a local alert snapshot; routing depends on site configuration.

name: After-Hours Entry Verification
tagline: Reports the person count, crossing direction, vehicle presence, and nearest second-person distance observed when a credential grant lands outside configured open hours.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose credential grants are checked against the schedule.
config_schema.door_line: Two-point line across the doorway that crossing direction is counted against.
config_schema.open_hours: Site-local [start, end] hours treated as open; grants outside them open a verification window (default [7, 19]).
config_schema.window_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after the grant before the record is emitted (default 20).
config_schema.escort_distance: Normalized frame distance under which a second person is reported as close by (default 0.25).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for the observed counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).

name: After-Hours Equipment-Zone Presence
tagline: Flags detected people or vehicles in a configured equipment zone outside scheduled crew hours; it does not establish theft.

config_schema.zone: Polygon for the laydown yard or equipment area.
config_schema.crew_hours: UTC start and end hours for scheduled crew presence (default [6, 17]).
config_schema.weekends_active: Whether weekday crew hours also apply on weekends (default true).

name: After-Hours Supply-Zone Activity
tagline: Flags person presence in the configured supply zone outside work hours and saves a local alert snapshot.

name: After-Hours Unlock Command Report
tagline: Reports controller-logged unlock commands that fall outside a configured site-local schedule. It records the event for human review and never issues, cancels, or reverses an unlock.

config_schema.door_id: Optional Access door ID or exact door name; unset accepts events from every configured door.
config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).
config_schema.closed_hours: Two site-local hours [start,end] defining the closed interval (default [20,6]).

name: Assembly Stage Order Review
tagline: Uses independent station-specific weights to compare observed stage candidates with a configured sequence; all exceptions require operator verification.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied station-stage model weights
config_schema.expected_sequence: list — ordered normalized stage labels, maximum 32

name: ATM Vestibule Watch
tagline: Flags overlapping person detections in a configured ATM vestibule for branch-security review.

name: Audited Door Unlock Request
tagline: Accepts an explicit operator-selected door, reason, and request identifier; verifies the door allowlist and separate access-control capability; records the attempt and result; and only then submits one unlock request. It is never triggered automatically by analytics, alarms, or emergency...

config_schema.door_id: Optional Access door ID or exact door name; unset accepts events from every configured door.
config_schema.reason_required: Require a non-empty operator reason for every unlock request (default true).
config_schema.door_allowlist: List of Access door IDs that this function may request to unlock; empty denies every request.

name: Authorized Plate-List Review
tagline: Matches locally recognized plate-text candidates against a customer-authorized list and emits only a digest plus masked suffix for review.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied plate-region model weights
config_schema.cooldown_seconds: int — repeat-alert suppression per plate digest (default 300)

name: Bus Loop Safety
tagline: Flags vehicles detected in a configured bus-loop exclusion zone during selected school-arrival windows.

name: Camera View Baseline Check
tagline: Flags a configured view region when edge structure drops below its learned baseline; camera movement, obstruction, and lighting changes can produce alerts.

config_schema.zone: Polygon for the view region to compare with its learned baseline.
config_schema.edge_drop_ratio: Fractional edge-structure drop that triggers review (default 0.5).
config_schema.check_hour: UTC hour for the daily baseline comparison (default 6).

name: Camera View Change Alert
tagline: Flags substantial edge-density loss or frame change from the learned reference; confirm detection and delivery timing during commissioning.

name: Clip Export Checksum Manifest
tagline: SHA-256, byte size, camera ID, requested interval, and local path for each completed export.

config_schema.digest_seconds: Minimum interval between bounded aggregate records (default 900).
config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Clip Export Daily Manifest
tagline: Daily manifest of requested and completed exports, including failures, intervals, paths, sizes, and checksums.

config_schema.digest_seconds: Minimum interval between bounded aggregate records (default 900).
config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Clip Export Integrity Probe
tagline: Downloaded-file presence, nonzero size, and optional ffprobe container/duration results; it does not certify evidentiary authenticity.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Clip Export Queue
tagline: Pending, running, completed, and failed states for bounded clip-export jobs.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Clip Export Search Index
tagline: Local index of exported-clip camera ID, start, end, path, byte size, and trigger type without content inference.

config_schema.digest_seconds: Minimum interval between bounded aggregate records (default 900).
config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Configured Object Removal Review
tagline: Learns a bounded object-count baseline in a configured asset zone and flags sustained count loss for verification.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named asset_zone — normalized polygon
config_schema.class_ids: list — numeric model classes to count

name: Conveyor Stalled-Object Review
tagline: Flags a tracked non-person object that remains nearly stationary in the belt zone beyond the configured threshold; operators verify a jam.

name: Crane Exclusion-Zone Presence Alert
tagline: Flags a person detected in a calibrated crane exclusion zone; verify operating state and alert routing through site procedures.

name: Credential-to-Crossing Correlation
tagline: Counts directional person crossings of a configured doorway line in the window after each credential grant and flags windows with more crossings than the configured allowance.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose credential grants open the correlation window.
config_schema.door_line: Two-point line across the doorway that person crossings are counted against.
config_schema.window_seconds: Seconds after a credential grant during which crossings are attributed to it (default 12).
config_schema.inbound: Crossing direction counted as an entry: forward or backward (default forward).
config_schema.crossings_per_grant: Inbound crossings allowed per credential grant before review (default 1).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for crossing counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).

name: Crowd Density Alert
tagline: Flags estimated crowd density above a configured threshold in a calibrated floor zone.

name: Curbside Pickup Arrival
tagline: Flags a vehicle entering the configured curbside zone; notification timing depends on processing and routing.

name: Denied-Access Escalation
tagline: Groups repeated denied-credential events at one door inside a rolling window and reports the observed person count and longest approach dwell once the threshold is reached.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose denied credentials are grouped.
config_schema.approach_zone: Polygon for the approach area that person count and dwell are measured in; unset uses the whole frame.
config_schema.window_seconds: Rolling window in which denials are grouped together (default 300).
config_schema.min_denials: Denials required inside the window before a record is emitted (default 3).
config_schema.cooldown_seconds: Minimum seconds between emitted records for the same door (default 600).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for the observed counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).

name: Door Alarm Duration Ledger
tagline: Pairs a controller-reported forced-open or held-open event with the next door-closed event at the same door and records the elapsed time. Unmatched alarms remain open records rather than receiving an assumed duration.

config_schema.door_id: Optional Access door ID or exact door name; unset accepts events from every configured door.
config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).
config_schema.digest_seconds: Minimum interval between bounded aggregate records (default 900).

name: Door Alarm Recurrence Summary
tagline: Counts forced-open and held-open events per door in configurable rolling and daily windows, reporting recurrence for operator review without assigning cause or intent.

config_schema.door_id: Optional Access door ID or exact door name; unset accepts events from every configured door.
config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).
config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).

name: Door Close Event Gap Review
tagline: Reports when no door-closed event is observed within a configured interval after a granted event or logged unlock command. It states only that confirmation was absent from the collected logs and does not assert physical door state.

config_schema.door_id: Optional Access door ID or exact door name; unset accepts events from every configured door.
config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).
config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).

name: Door Operation Verification
tagline: After a remote unlock command, reports whether a person crossed the doorway line and how far the door zone drifted from its pre-command reference during the verification window.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose unlock commands open the verification window.
config_schema.door_line: Two-point line across the doorway that person crossings are counted against.
config_schema.door_zone: Polygon for the door leaf area compared against its pre-command reference.
config_schema.verify_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after the unlock command before the record is emitted (default 20).
config_schema.change_threshold: Normalized frame-difference above which the door zone is reported as changed (default 0.06).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for crossing counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).

name: Door-Zone Baseline Change
tagline: Flags a configured door region that remains visually different from its learned reference beyond the threshold; verify the door state during commissioning.

config_schema.zone: Polygon for the door region to compare with its learned reference.
config_schema.propped_seconds: Seconds of sustained visual difference before review (default 90).

name: Drive-Thru Service Timer
tagline: Measures observed vehicle time between configured order-point and exit zones.

name: Egress-Zone Object Review
tagline: Flags a persistent object in a configured egress zone for staff review.

name: EV Charger Blocked
tagline: The stall is for charging, not all-day parking.

name: Event Pre/Post-Roll Clip Export
tagline: Clip bytes for a configurable interval before and after an event timestamp, subject to a hard duration cap.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Floor Appearance Change Review
tagline: Flags sustained changes in a bounded floor-zone appearance metric for inspection; it does not confirm water or a leak.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named floor_review — normalized polygon

name: Footfall & Occupancy Counter
tagline: Estimated entry counts and live occupancy from a calibrated camera view.

name: Forced/Held-Open Video Verification
tagline: Summarizes the people, vehicles, other detected objects, and longest person dwell observed while an Access forced-open or held-open door alarm was active.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose door-state alarms open the observation window.
config_schema.door_zone: Polygon for the door area that person dwell is measured in; unset measures the whole frame.
config_schema.observe_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after the alarm before the summary is emitted (default 30).
config_schema.detection_confidence: Detection confidence used for the observed counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).

name: Forecourt Dwell Watch
tagline: Flags extended person dwell in configured forecourt zones during selected hours.

name: Forklift–Pedestrian Proximity Review
tagline: Uses independent domain weights to flag close person and forklift tracks in image space for human safety review.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied person/forklift model weights

name: Hallway Overnight Presence
tagline: Flags person detections in configured building areas during selected after-hours for staff review.

name: Hardhat Visibility Review
tagline: Flags person boxes where the configured PPE model did not observe a hardhat candidate; requires visual verification and does not determine compliance.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied PPE model weights

name: High-Visibility Vest Review
tagline: Flags person boxes where the configured PPE model did not observe a high-visibility vest candidate; requires visual verification and does not determine compliance.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied PPE model weights

name: Last Good Frame Snapshot
tagline: After a stream-health failure, the most recent successfully decoded frame is retained only when privacy and retention settings allow.

config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: Laundromat Overnight Watch
tagline: Flags extended person dwell in configured laundromat zones during selected overnight hours.

name: Loitering Watch
tagline: Flags person dwell in a configured zone beyond the selected review threshold.

name: Low-Luminance Lighting Watch
tagline: Flags sustained low luminance in a configured area during scheduled lit hours.

config_schema.lit_hours: Scheduled hours when the area is expected to be lit, expressed as [start, end] in 24-hour time; default: [18, 6].

name: Machine-Row Dwell Watch
tagline: Flags a person-class track remaining in a configured machine-row zone beyond the dwell threshold.

name: Magnet-Crane Exclusion-Zone Alert
tagline: Flags a person detected in a configured magnet-crane exclusion zone; verify operating state and alert routing through site procedures.

config_schema.zone: polygon — exclusion area under crane/magnet path

name: Manual Bounded Clip Export
tagline: A user-requested camera/time range exported with mandatory start, end, and maximum-duration checks.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Motion Event Clip Export
tagline: A bounded clip around a polled motion event, labeled as motion only and not as an incident.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Multi-Camera Clip Bundle
tagline: Separate bounded exports from selected cameras for the same operator-supplied interval, packaged without claiming synchronization.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Occupancy Flow Anomaly Review
tagline: Compares anonymous person counts with a local rolling median and flags material high or low deviations after sufficient samples.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named occupancy — normalized polygon

name: Occupancy Reconciliation
tagline: Reports the site-day difference between credentialed door passages counted by Access and directional person crossings counted on the configured line.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose credential grants are counted.
config_schema.count_line: Two-point line across the doorway that person crossings are counted against.
config_schema.summary_hour: Site-local hour at which the daily reconciliation is emitted (default 23).
config_schema.min_difference: Smallest absolute difference between the two totals that is reported (default 2).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for crossing counts (default 0.45).

name: Overnight Parking Watch
tagline: Flags vehicles that remain in configured parking zones during selected restricted hours.

name: Parking Lot Occupancy
tagline: Live lot count. Full-lot alerts. Zero sensors in the pavement.

name: Pedestrian–Vehicle Conflict Review
tagline: Flags close image-plane person and road-vehicle detections for visual review; it does not determine that a near miss occurred.

name: Per-Tenant After-Hours Watch
tagline: Applies per-tenant zones and schedules to after-hours person-detection alerts.

name: Perimeter Climbing-Pose Review
tagline: Flags a sustained pose heuristic near a configured perimeter boundary for verification; it does not identify intent.

config_schema.boundary: camera zone named perimeter_boundary — two-point line in normalized coordinates

name: Persistent Object Review
tagline: Flags a stationary object after the configured dwell threshold for human review; detection and delivery latency vary by deployment.

name: Pool-Area Person Count
tagline: Counts detected people in a calibrated pool and deck zone and flags sustained counts above a configured review threshold.

name: Possible Fall Review
tagline: Flags a sustained horizontal-pose signature and saves an alert snapshot for human review; calibrate per camera.

name: Protect Camera Discovery Failure Log
tagline: Timestamped login, transport, HTTP, or parsing failures encountered during camera discovery.

config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).
config_schema.inventory_poll_seconds: Seconds between shared Protect camera inventory refreshes (default 60).

name: Protect Camera Offline Watch
tagline: A camera state returned as anything other than CONNECTED, recorded for operator review.

config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).
config_schema.inventory_poll_seconds: Seconds between shared Protect camera inventory refreshes (default 60).

name: Protect Event Camera Reference Audit
tagline: Event camera references that are blank or do not match the latest discovered camera IDs.

config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).

name: Protect Event Poll Health
tagline: Poll success, HTTP status, returned row count, and request duration.

config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).

name: Protect Unnamed Camera Records
tagline: Discovered camera records with a blank or missing name.

config_schema.inventory_poll_seconds: Seconds between shared Protect camera inventory refreshes (default 60).

name: Queue Abandonment Review
tagline: Flags an anonymous track that leaves a configured queue after sustained waiting without entering the service zone.

config_schema.queue_zone: camera zone named queue — normalized polygon
config_schema.service_zone: camera zone named service — normalized polygon

name: Queue Length Monitor
tagline: Flags sustained person-count estimates above a configured queue threshold for staff review.

name: Raised-Arm Motion Review
tagline: Flags a sustained raised-arm, high-motion pose signature for calibrated staff review; it does not predict violence.

name: Rapid Gate-Crossing Review
tagline: Flags a second tracked vehicle crossing the configured gate line within the review window; it does not associate crossings with an access code.

config_schema.window_seconds: Seconds in which a second vehicle crossing triggers review (default 8).

name: Remote Unlock Event Ledger
tagline: Writes a bounded audit ledger from controller-reported remote, API, or manual unlock-command events, retaining door, timestamp, event ID, and reported method while keeping actor data opt-in.

config_schema.door_id: Optional Access door ID or exact door name; unset accepts events from every configured door.
config_schema.event_window_seconds: Maximum age in seconds for a normalized controller event to be considered (default 300).
config_schema.digest_seconds: Minimum interval between bounded aggregate records (default 900).

name: Restricted Parking Dwell Review
tagline: Flags a sustained vehicle-class track in a configured restricted-parking zone; policy or violation status remains an operator decision.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named restricted_parking — normalized polygon

name: Restricted-Zone Person Presence
tagline: Flags a sustained person detection in a calibrated restricted zone; alert delivery time depends on the camera, runtime, network, and routing configuration.

config_schema.hold_ms: Detection debounce duration in milliseconds (default: 300); not an end-to-end alert-time commitment.

name: RTSP Black Frame Rate
tagline: Share of decoded frames whose mean luminance falls below a configured black-frame threshold.

config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).
config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: RTSP Blur Score Monitor
tagline: Variance-of-Laplacian sharpness score from decoded frames, reported as an image metric rather than a focus diagnosis.

config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: RTSP Connectivity Probe
tagline: Whether the discovered RTSP/S stream can be opened and one frame decoded inside the timeout.

config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: RTSP Decode Error Rate
tagline: Failed frame reads divided by attempted reads, with transport errors kept separate.

config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).
config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: RTSP Frame Gap Watch
tagline: Observed local time gaps between successfully decoded frames above a configured threshold.

config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).
config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: RTSP Freeze Watch
tagline: A run of nearly identical decoded frames based on frame hashes; static scenes can also trigger review.

config_schema.event_threshold: Number of matching observations required in the bounded window (default 3).
config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: RTSP Rolling Quality Digest
tagline: Time-bucket summary of decode health, frame gaps, effective FPS, luminance, contrast, and sharpness metrics.

config_schema.digest_seconds: Minimum interval between bounded aggregate records (default 900).
config_schema.sample_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between sampled decoded frames (default 30).
config_schema.alert_threshold: Profile-specific numeric threshold; commission against the installed camera and scene.

name: Service-Zone Dwell Alert
tagline: Flags tracked person dwell in a service zone when a configured comparison zone has no person detection.

name: Shared-Lane Vehicle Motion Alert
tagline: Flags tracked vehicle motion above a camera-calibrated image-space threshold in a configured shared lane; human review required.

config_schema.max_px_per_sec: Number — calibrated normalized image-space motion threshold per second.

name: Shipping Label Presence Review
tagline: Uses independent package/label weights to flag a sustained package box without an associated label center for verification.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied package-and-label model weights

name: Small-Person Restricted-Zone Alert
tagline: Flags a person detection below a calibrated image-height threshold in a restricted zone for immediate human review; it does not determine age.

config_schema.max_height_ratio: float — calibrated image-height threshold (default 0.35); not an age estimate

name: Smart-Detect Event Clip Export
tagline: A bounded clip around a polled smartDetectZone event, preserving any supplied subtype as unverified metadata.

config_schema.pre_seconds: Seconds requested before an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 5).
config_schema.post_seconds: Seconds requested after an accepted event, bounded to the local export policy (default 10).
config_schema.max_clip_bytes: Maximum accepted clip bytes before the export is rejected (default 104857600).

name: Smoke & Flame Visual Review
tagline: Routes persistent smoke/flame model candidates or a tuned warm-region heuristic for human review; supplemental only and never a replacement for life-safety sensors.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied smoke/flame weights; heuristic is used when absent

name: Splash Pad Capacity
tagline: Flags estimated occupancy above the configured splash-pad capacity threshold for supervisor review.

name: Stopped Vehicle Lane Review
tagline: Flags a vehicle-class track with sustained low image-plane movement inside a configured lane; it does not measure physical speed.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named traffic_lane — normalized polygon

name: Traffic Queue Spillback Review
tagline: Flags a sustained vehicle count above a configured threshold in a spillback zone for operator review.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named spillback — normalized polygon

name: Truck Yard Dwell Estimate
tagline: Measures tracked-truck dwell from first presence in a configured yard or dock zone until the track leaves; it does not identify carriers.

config_schema.zone: Polygon for the yard or dock area to monitor.
config_schema.slow_minutes: Minutes of continuous tracked presence before review (default 120).

name: Unusual Dwell Baseline Review
tagline: Learns completed anonymous dwell times locally and flags a current track materially above the rolling median after sufficient samples.

config_schema.zone: camera zone named dwell_baseline — normalized polygon
config_schema.min_samples: int — completed dwell samples before evaluation (default 20)
config_schema.minimum_seconds: int — absolute minimum dwell before review (default 60)

name: Unusual Motion Baseline Review
tagline: Learns local frame-to-frame motion energy and flags sustained increases above the rolling median for visual review.

config_schema.anomaly_factor: float — multiplier over median motion energy (default 3)

name: Vehicle Attribute Candidate Log
tagline: Records bounded, model-provided vehicle class or appearance candidates for review; attributes are not identity and require domain weights.

config_schema.weights: path — independently supplied vehicle-attribute model weights

name: Vehicle Wrong-Way Crossing Review
tagline: Flags vehicle-class tracks crossing a configured line opposite its allowed direction; physical speed is not inferred.

config_schema.line: camera zone named vehicle_direction_line — two-point line in normalized coordinates

name: Verified Door Incident Timeline
tagline: Joins each configured Access door event with the person counts observed on the correlated camera during the review window and emits one consolidated record.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name to correlate; unset correlates every door in the event buffer.
config_schema.door_zone: Polygon for the doorway area counted during the review window; unset counts the whole frame.
config_schema.review_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after each door event before the record is emitted (default 12).
config_schema.event_kinds: Access kinds to record from granted, denied, forced_open, held_open, doorbell, unlock_command, door_closed (default all).
config_schema.person_confidence: Person-detection confidence used for the observed counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).

name: Visitor Entry Review Context
tagline: Collects the people, carried-item classes, and vehicles observed after a doorbell or access-request event and emits one operator review record; it never unlocks a door.

config_schema.door_id: Access door id or door name whose doorbell or access-request events open the review window.
config_schema.door_zone: Polygon for the entry area that observations are limited to; unset uses the whole frame.
config_schema.review_seconds: Seconds of observation collected after the event before the record is emitted (default 20).
config_schema.detection_confidence: Detection confidence used for the observed counts (default 0.45).
config_schema.include_actor: Include the Access actor name in the emitted record (default false).
